==Usage==
This can be used to cite the Fact File from its original run ([[2002]]&ndash;[[2005]]). Place the following code on the page and replace the "issue number" with the appropriate information.
*<nowiki>{{</nowiki>FFCite|ISSUE NUMBER|PAGE RANGE|ENTRY}} (new way)

==Example==
====Code====
*<nowiki>{{FactFile|105|YAD 1-2|Yaddle}}</nowiki>
====Result====
*{{FactFile|105|YAD 1-2|Yaddle}}
